## Independently checked central claims

1. **Actual unstable v2, not v1 or a typed-values feature label.** Header macros declare API2.0.0 and gate unstable constructs; the extension header rejects mixed v1/v2 families and says no v2 function is stabilized. This is an API-source version, not an installed/release/future-ABI guarantee. [Public header66–121](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/include/duckdb_v2.h#L66-L121), [extension header14–78](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/include/duckdb_extension_v2.h#L14-L78).

2. **Producer rather than completed-relation ingress.** The table builder requires bind+exec and installs the inspected leaf producer callbacks; table bind arguments are constant Values, not an exposed SQL-child chunk stream. Bind-data copies share the opaque owner. Scan-global/default init thread counts are1, with separate execution state. These support the proposed narrow egress inference, not arbitrary child ingestion or safe mutable bind cursors. [Builder782–837](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/main/capi/v2/capi_v2_func_table.cpp#L782-L837), [constant bind data121–135](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/include/duckdb/main/capi_v2/capi_v2_function_internal.hpp#L121-L135), [shared bind owner/default scan state18–63](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/main/capi/v2/capi_v2_func_table.cpp#L18-L63), [init defaults146–157](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/main/capi/v2/capi_v2_func_table.cpp#L146-L157).

3. **Concrete schema, borrowed batches and database-visible registration.** At least one concrete result column is required; ANY is explicitly rejected for data-bearing columns. Callback output is borrowed for that callback, begins empty, and the first vector's size becomes batch cardinality; zero exhausts the scan. Connection registration is database-visible subject to transaction commit/rollback, requires a same-database factory, and is not a private connection closure. [Column declaration12909–12928](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/include/duckdb_v2.h#L12909-L12928), [callback batch13289–13308](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/include/duckdb_v2.h#L13289-L13308), [actual cardinality bridge581–625](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/main/capi/v2/capi_v2_func_table.cpp#L581-L625), [registration13886–13934](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/include/duckdb_v2.h#L13886-L13934).

4. **Scalar/aggregate are materially different boundaries.** Scalar exec receives current input/result vectors. Aggregate construction requires combine, update exports row/state arrays, finalize passes an offset, and destruction drops reported errors. Exact standalone arithmetic does not supply disjoint-support/full-tuple merge, NULL handling or global error-priority contracts. [Scalar201–285](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/main/capi/v2/capi_v2_func_scalar.cpp#L201-L285), [aggregate223–375](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/main/capi/v2/capi_v2_func_aggregate.cpp#L223-L375).

5. **Type/NULL/NUL admission cannot be delegated to successful getters.** ReadAs converts mismatched types; the public BIGINT getter and fallback writer expressly permit default casts. The public byte view is length-delimited and allows interior NUL, unlike the project's stricter string domain; text UTF8 responsibility is not complete project admission. Primitive/nested/UNION declarations support carrier investigation, but no particular UNION/STRUCT carrier or DOUBLE word round-trip is accepted. [ReadAs55–83](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/main/capi/v2/capi_v2_value.cpp#L55-L83), [getter14583–14599](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/include/duckdb_v2.h#L14583-L14599), [views446–485](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/include/duckdb_v2.h#L446-L485), [types8953–9068](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/include/duckdb_v2.h#L8953-L9068).

6. **Borrowed vector/validity/string lifetimes are substantive.** Flat/constant/dictionary views use different selections; dictionary reads can flatten a shared child and invalidate aliases. Child vectors belong to chunks; callback output has the shorter callback lifetime. Arenas are borrowed and invalidated by flatten/reallocation/destruction. Nested NULL writes must preserve descendants, and default function NULL behavior may omit callback invocation. These support the research's explicit ownership/strict-admission prerequisites, not a generic flat-buffer assumption. [Actual view144–194](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/main/capi/v2/capi_v2_vector.cpp#L144-L194), [alias warning11340–11370](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/include/duckdb_v2.h#L11340-L11370), [nested validity/arena11612–11739](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/include/duckdb_v2.h#L11612-L11739), [NULL properties691–743](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/include/duckdb_v2.h#L691-L743).

7. **Interruption and atomic visibility remain separate.** The public interrupt declaration permits cross-thread same-connection cancellation; step reports CANCELLED while blocking fetch reports runtime-interrupt error. Already fetched chunks are caller-owned and survive result destruction, so reducer completion-before-egress does not itself retract previously consumed chunks after a later host error. This is a visibility inference, not a reproduced failure or permission to start threads. Accepted filters are an exact predicate promise, and scan order metadata does not establish every downstream SQL plan's order. [Interrupt2001–2019](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/include/duckdb_v2.h#L2001-L2019), [stream12148–12225](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/include/duckdb_v2.h#L12148-L12225), [pushdown12807–12854](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/include/duckdb_v2.h#L12807-L12854).

## Error discrepancy and added qualification Q1

The reported null-info discrepancy is independently confirmed: both setter comments promise successful no-op for null info; both implementation bodies return INPUT_INVALID. This is a pinned comment/body disagreement, not an observed runtime failure or proof that live callback code propagation is broken. Ordinary WithErrorHandler return codes are authoritative and success may leave stale detail; callback bridges instead pass a live local error object and propagate its code. [Setter comments2532–2565](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/include/duckdb_v2.h#L2532-L2565), [setter bodies23–48](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/main/capi/v2/capi_v2_error.cpp#L23-L48), [wrapper756–837](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/include/duckdb/main/capi_v2/capi_v2_internal.hpp#L756-L837).

**Q1:** text-setting directly assigns the owned string and resets raw detail without a local WithErrorHandler/catch. The view conversion is not an owned allocation, but copying text into the owned message can allocate. Thus non-nullness alone cannot close error-allocation/nonthrowing translation, and the inspected generic wrapper's exception-to-code guarantee must not be generalized to this setter without another proven boundary. I did not establish an outer/caller failure boundary or reproduce exception escape. This is an additional narrow source-risk qualification within already-open error prerequisites, not a selected remedy/adapter plan. [Direct setter23–31](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/main/capi/v2/capi_v2_error.cpp#L23-L31), [borrowed conversion75–89](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/blob/d54cbbe3df17e8e5ce68312f483b4155836112aa/src/include/duckdb/main/capi_v2/capi_v2_internal.hpp#L75-L89).
